title: Quality slipping or a knock off
text: Quality slipping or a knock off. Ordered 3 of thee BUBBA cups. I have used them for years. However these 3 have sharp handle edges and a very sharp top rim of the inner liner right at your drinking lips. Either quality has slipped or they are knock offs. Will NEVER order again online.

product_metadata.title: Bubba Envy Tumbler, 24 oz, Pink
features: Dual-wall insulation keeps drinks cold longer and helps reduce sweating
Body and lid are made of impact-, stain-, and odor-resistant BPA-free plastic
Body and lid are dishwasher-safe for easy cleanups
description: Whether you’re going to the beach or stopping by a backyard barbecue, the dual-wall bubba Envy S Vacuum-Insulated Stainless Steel Tumbler with Straw, 24 oz., will keep your favorite drink cold up to 18 hours without sweating so you can enjoy the moment. Its easy-to-clean lid features a smooth lip, allowing you to drink with or without the plastic straw. The BPA-free lid is made of superior impact-, stain-, and odor-resistant plastic so you won’t have to worry about lingering tastes or smells. Road trip? You’ll be happy to know that your tumbler easily fits most car cup holders, and the silicone base pad prevents slipping and sliding on other surfaces. At the end of the day, throw the lid and straw onto the top rack of your dishwasher for a no-fuss cleanup, but remember to hand-wash the body. Rest assured. Comes in a 2-pack of 24 oz. tumblers.
